text.en: These Rules may be cited as the Criminal Procedure (Allowance to Witnesses)

The rates of payments which the Court may order to be paid out of the Treasury to witnesses both for the prosecution and for the defence, or to such of them as the Court thinks fit, in criminal cases shall be those prescribed in Schedule 1.

The certificate required by section 385 shall be in the form prescribed in 6 CAP. 7.R2 Criminal Procedure Code - [Subsidiary] (rule 2) Rates of allowances to witnesses payable in Brunei Darussalam in respect of criminal proceedings in -

(a) the High Court -

(i) Expert witness - $8.50 plus reasonable for each hour of attendance travelling expenses.

(ii) Other witnesses Such allowance plus reasonable travelling expenses as the Court may think fit, having due regard to the circumstances of Provided that such allowance does not exceed $25 per diem.

(b) Courts of Magistrate's -

(i) Expert witness - $8.50 plus reasonable for each hour of attendance travelling expenses.

(ii) Other witnesses Such allowance plus reasonable travelling expenses as the Court may think fit, having due regard to the circumstances of Provided that such allowance does not exceed $10 per diem. (rule 3)

CERTIFICATE UNDER SECTION 385 OF THE CRIMINAL PROCEDURE CODE (CHAPTER 7) 1 certify that .................................................................................................................. attended at the ...................................................................................................... Court to give evidence on ................................. for ....................... days, and* (that, in accordance with these Rules, the sum allowable to him at $ ............................................................... per diem is $ .............................................. ). I further certify that the following charges made by the said ...................................... ....................................................... in respect of his actual travelling expenses appear to me to be fair and reasonable. Dated this ................................................ day of ..................................... 20 .............. applicable
